notes: DSH shows a 0.1.7 window as reconnecting because its WebSocket stream cannot be opened through the scheme; Mnemon's requests are plain HTTP and unaffected. The screenshots are cropped to the Memory System.

The remote page shows the Runtime memory Source's own read-only line ('当前为只读模式…') under the new reason; the probe looked for the 0.5.18 wording, so its readOnlyNotice flag for that run was read from the screenshot.
